title: Network
summary: Network diagnostics that work without internet: iperf3, mtr, iw, wavemon, dig, tcpdump and the tools of WireGuard, and telnet (does a port answer; a client only). Use them to find the cause of a hotspot or link problem.
consent: tcpdump can read every packet on the box. iperf3 listens for a test partner only when you start it. Install the toolkit only while you need it.
notes: install.sh installs nftables and iw with the box. This toolkit adds the tools for problems with the radio or the link.
To measure the throughput of the hotspot, do these steps. Run iperf3 -s on the box. Run iperf3 -c <the box> on a phone or laptop.
wavemon shows the signal and the rate of the link as they change. iw dev <iface> station dump lists the signal and the rate of each guest.
